title: Dissociating Answerability from Extraction in LLM Question Answering over Radiology Reports
abstract: arXiv:2610.17576v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Answering questions from radiology reports involves two decisions: whether the report contains an answer and which span gives it. A false answer presents an unsupported claim as fact; an over-abstention hides what the report says. Yet RadQA results are reported as a single F1 that merges both. We propose an evaluation method that separates them, reporting false-answer and over-abstention rates beside F1 and splitting F1 changes into extraction and answerability terms. We apply it to 13 LLMs on the RadQA test set, zero-shot and with three cumulative demonstration sets, the last adding an unanswerable example. Models with similar F1 differed more than twofold in false-answer rate. The unanswerable example changed when models answered, not how well they extracted: 12 of 13 models abstained more often, and three-quarters of the answers they withdrew had F1 $\geq$ 0.5. Within models, false answers showed no clear association with extraction

translated_title: 在放射报告的LLM问答中将可回答性与答案抽取解耦
translated_abstract: 从放射学报告中回答问题涉及两个决策：报告是否包含答案，以及哪个文本片段给出了答案。错误的回答会将无依据的断言当作事实呈现；过度弃答则会隐藏报告中已有的信息。然而RadQA的结果却以单一的F1分数报告，将两者混为一谈。我们提出了一种将两者分离的评估方法，在F1之外同时报告错误回答率和过度弃答率，并将F1的变化分解为抽取项和可回答性项。我们将其应用于RadQA测试集上的13个大语言模型，包括零样本设置和三个累积的示例集，其中最后一个加入了不可回答的示例。F1相近的模型在错误回答率上差异超过两倍。不可回答示例改变的是模型何时作答，而非其抽取答案的质量：13个模型中有12个更频繁地弃答，而它们撤回的答案中有四分之三的F1≥0.5。在模型内部，错误回答与抽取能力之间没有明确的关联。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将错误回答与过度弃答分离的评估方法，用以独立衡量LLM在放射报告问答中的可回答性判断与答案抽取能力，发现F1相近的模型错误回答率可相差两倍以上，且加入不可回答示例主要改变模型的弃答行为而非抽取质量。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an evaluation method that disentangles answerability from answer extraction in LLM question answering over radiology reports, revealing that models with similar F1 differ more than twofold in false-answer rates and that unanswerable examples change when models answer rather than how well they extract.
